summary.zh: 前中共中央總書記胡耀邦於 1989 年 4 月 15 日病逝。悼念他的海報隨即出現在北京各高校。
summary.en: Former General Secretary Hu Yaobang died on 15 April 1989. Posters mourning him soon appeared on Beijing campuses.
